notes.title: 📍 Leaf Blower Co. Demo Major Update - Based on Your Feedback
notes.notes: [h2]🌱 Hey there! Your feedback has helped us make Leaf Blower Co. even better! [/h2][p][/p][p]As you might have seen in our previous post, we are heading to Cologne for [b]Gamescom 2025[/b]. The event runs from [b]20 to 24 August[/b] and if you are also attending, you can come meet us in person.[/p][p]We will be at [b]The Indie Arena Booth[/b] where you can try out Forklift games, chat with the team, pick up exclusive giveaways and snap some fun photos with us. We will be there in full leaf blowing spirit and would love to meet you.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621723/701ae711b27646b73e20922e022403b2540b43ab.png"][/img][/p][p]But there is more. Steam is already featuring all Gamescom participants today and to celebrate we have updated the [b]Leaf Blower Co. Demo[/b]. This update is based directly on your feedback and we are incredibly grateful for all the suggestions, bug reports and ideas you have shared. They have helped us make the game even better for everyone. Thank you![/p][p][/p][p]And as special treat, we've even switched out one of the Freeplay levels - jump into the calming zen of the new Japanese Courtyard location now![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3720140/Leaf_Blower_Co_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3][b]🆕 New Content and Features[/b][/h3][list][*][p]New job selection board: all jobs are now represented as postcards on a map, including bonus jobs[/p][/*][*][p]Mushrooms added (similar to weeds) to burn on ground and trees[/p][/*][*][p]New level unlocked after first area cleared (not seen before in the demo)[/p][/*][*][p]New "No Zones Mode" Prototype available in HUB — play without zones[/p][/*][*][p]Bonus Work now has random weather and time[/p][/*][*][p]Air now blows along the ground instead of just at leaves which are pointed at directly[/p][/*][*][p]New butterflies added to the Mayor’s house[/p][/*][*][p]Clean wipes happen in each zone for every 25% of total leaves collected in that zone[/p][/*][/list][p][b]🎮 Gameplay Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]XP now earned twice as fast[/p][/*][*][p]Leaves are randomly dispersed on each level every time you play[/p][/*][*][p]Crows are random across all levels they’re in[/p][/*][*][p]Weeds are random across all levels they’re in[/p][/*][*][p]Leaves will not get kicked forward in first person mode but will in 3rd person mode[/p][/*][*][p]Tarp bag stacking improved[/p][/*][*][p]Bins now have a cluster mode that counts leaves blown into them continuously until 3 seconds have elapsed without any getting blown in, then displays and awards points[/p][/*][*][p]Bins count down the number of leaves remaining[/p][/*][*][p]Ground Circle on for Shredder, off for Leafblower (default setting)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]🎨 Visuals and UI[/b][/p][list][*][p]New animations and floor wipes for cleared areas (every 25% cleared) with on-screen indication[/p][/*][*][p]UI updates to show progression[/p][/*][*][p]Ground circle indicator off by default, can be enabled in Settings → General[/p][/*][*][p]FOV now available as an option in Settings[/p][/*][*][p]The TAB key now toggles the HUD on and off[/p][/*][*][p]Cursor reverted to standard cursor to avoid input lag issue on menus[/p][/*][*][p]Emissive leaves always off even at night[/p][/*][/list][p][b]🔊 Audio[/b][/p][list][*][p]Lots of sounds removed for a more zen experience[/p][/*][/list][p][b]🏠 World Interactions[/b][/p][list][*][p]Shower can now be turned off in Mayor's house[/p][/*][/list][p][b]💡 Quality of Life[/b][/p][list][*][p]Update to pop-up tips[/p][/*][*][p]Random jobs no longer set in pitch dark (can still be called from freeplay)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]🐞 Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Snow no longer collects on pipes so numbers can always be seen clearly regardless of weather[/p][/*][*][p]Coconuts no longer play audio for too long when under water[/p][/*][*][p]Boxes in suburb fixed so they no longer disappear[/p][/*][*][p]POV bug fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Weeds and crow counts fixed so they match the objectives[/p][/*][*][p]Mushroom counts fixed on the side underneath the level indicator[/p][/*][*][p]Bug with "mushroom taken care of" text on the UI causing the level radial wheel to be the wrong size is now fixed[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][i]— The Leaf Blower Team[/i][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/vpqqamaEbJ" style="button"]JOIN OUR DISCORD[/url][/p]

notes.title: Hotfix Update
notes.notes: [p][b]Minor Update: Freeplay Hint, Furniture Fix, and More[/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]You’ll now get a reminder about Freeplay mode when using the PC on Day 2, so it's easier to notice when it's available[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where furniture could behave oddly after being "fixed", it's now much more stable[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Added a helpful hint in Freeplay mode about turning on your headlamp at night[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks again for all your bug reports and feedback. Keep them coming 💚[/p]

notes.title: Hotfix Update
notes.notes: [p]Just pushed a small update with a few important fixes and tweaks:[/p][list][*][p]Objectives system adjustments[/p][/*][*][p]New notification added for Freeplay mode[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed stuck leaves on the Roman level[/p][/*][*][p]Additional performance improvements[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks for playing and sharing your feedback. More updates coming soon![/p][p][/p]
